trust_decision.summary: A door server callback decides whether the client-supplied argument buffer (argp/arg_size) is non-NULL and large enough to be treated as the request struct, before it dereferences or writes it; before the fix nwamd did no check and the netcfgd backend wrote into the NULL buffer inside its size-check branch.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'nwamd door handler'; nwamd_door_switch is the only door callback in nwamd (registered at usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/nwamd/door_if.c:626) and dereferences argp unconditionally at :547.

fix_sites.entry_point: door_call(3C) on NWAM_DOOR (/etc/svc/volatile/nwam/nwam_door, door file mode 0644, door_if.c:623) served by nwamd_door_switch

door_call(3C) on NWAM_BACKEND_DOOR_FILE served by nwam_backend_door_server, created in libnwam nwam_backend_init (libnwam_backend.c:363) and hosted by netcfgd (usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/netcfgd/netcfgd.c:172)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared library door server (lib/libnwam) hosted by a different daemon (netcfgd)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: usr/src/lib/libnwam/common/libnwam_backend.c:207-223 (nwam_backend_door_server, a separate door server in libnwam, run by netcfgd not nwamd: usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/netcfgd/netcfgd.c:172)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names nwamd; the backend door lives in libnwam, runs inside netcfgd, and already has an arg_size check (libnwam_backend.c:219), so a solver can argue it is a different daemon and already validated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Backend door requests legitimately carry a packed object list after the fixed header (arg_size up to NWAM_BACKEND_DOOR_ARG_SIZE) and the READ reply reuses the trailing space; an over-broad fix requiring arg_size == sizeof(struct) or rejecting nonzero nwbda_datalen breaks netcfg UPDATE/READ.

O6_input_shapes: non-NULL but short buffer (0 < arg_size < sizeof request struct)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Backend UPDATE unpacks nwbda_datalen bytes after the header with no check that datalen fits within arg_size (out-of-bounds read of the door buffer).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Reached only after nwam_check_auths for write (libnwam_backend.c:235), it is an over-read rather than the NULL dereference the advisory names, and the length field is a different check from arg_size.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site 2; different package from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Backend door_ucred failure path writes req and calls door_return without returning, then falls through to ucred_getruid(NULL) if door_return fails.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: door_return does not return on success, so the fall-through needs a door_return failure; it is not client-controllable input-shape validation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A datalen-vs-arg_size bound on the trailing packed object list, which the header-size check alone does not cover.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The header check and the payload length are separate fields; a maintainer adding only the header check (as the fix did) would plausibly not bound datalen.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Handlers strlcpy/strcmp request name fields that are never forced to be NUL-terminated within the received buffer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handlers trust the struct layout once the size check passes; a terminator check is a natural follow-on that an engineer could miss.

O9_family: memory safety: NULL pointer dereference / missing input-size validation in IPC (door) handler (CWE-476)

O10_build.toolchain: illumos build environment (nightly/bldenv, illumos gcc, onbld tools); builds only on an illumos host
O10_build.project_tests: No nwam tests under usr/src/test (glob usr/src/test/**/*nwam* empty); no unit tests for door_if.c or libnwam_backend.c found.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (argp == NULL) return;` at the top of nwamd_door_switch only, leaving short buffers and the netcfgd backend door (whose existing size check writes into the NULL req) untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: ipmgmtd's ipmgmt_handler dereferences argp with no NULL or size check (usr/src/cmd/cmd-inet/lib/ipmgmtd/ipmgmt_door.c:109-111); different daemon, not pursued.
unverified: Whether nwam_check_auths grants read to unprivileged users (affects reachability of the libnwam_backend.c:252 strlen on non-terminated nwbda_dbname) not checked.
